entries.topicDescription: Runtime application self-protection and obfuscation strategies.

tips.title: Hollow-shell pattern for RASP threat callbacks
tips.content:
Exposing your real ThreatEngine implementation as a keepClassMembers target
leaks its method structure to reverse engineers even under obfuscation,
since kept methods retain readable names and signatures.

Instead, expose a minimal hollow interface/shell class that DexGuard's runtime
hooks call into, and keep the actual detection logic in an internal,
fully-obfuscated implementation reached only through that shell — this is a
Proxy pattern applied specifically to minimize the attack surface exposed by
keep rules.
